title: Demo Preplan 1
hazards: High rack storage; large interior travel distances; commercial vehicle traffic; roof collapse potential under advanced fire conditions.
tacticalSummary: Large warehouse footprint. Establish command on the Alpha side, confirm sprinkler status, and maintain clear apparatus access to loading areas.
accessNotes: Primary apparatus access from Spahn Rd. Keep loading-dock lanes clear for secondary access and aerial positioning.
utilityNotes: Utility controls should be confirmed with site management on arrival. Verify fire pump and sprinkler control locations before shutdown.
